message: Renovate proposes major updates after 1 day (minimumReleaseAge: "1 day" in packageRules[0] of renovate.json), but Composer waits 3 days (config.policy.cooldown.period: 259200 in composer.json); its pull requests bring in versions younger than Composer accepts, or fail where the lockfile is re-checked
fix: Make minimumReleaseAge in packageRules[0] of renovate.json at least 3 days, or limit the rule to the packages that need a shorter delay
